module_summary: Virtual-FIFO encoder: packs AXI stream beats into per-segment RAMs, builds length/meta headers in a header FIFO, then muxes header-prefixed segments onto a segmented output with backpressure and padding timeout.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; with ready writes segments into segment RAMs.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, low when input or header FIFO full or fifo reset.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload split into segments.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end; trims segments and ends header block.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep; counts cycle length and valid segments on last beat.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: User sideband stored as header metadata.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data to virtual FIFO channel.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid; also resets block timeout.

anchors.name: fifo_watermark_in
anchors.why: Downstream watermark backpressure stalls output command generation.

anchors.name: fifo_rst_in
anchors.why: FIFO reset command clears pointers and blocks input ready.

anchors.name: seg_ram[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment input FIFO RAM storing packed stream data.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_len
anchors.why: Header FIFO RAM storing block lengths (with last/meta arrays).

anchors.name: input_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO write pointer advanced by written segment count.

anchors.name: input_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO read pointer advanced as segments are prefetched.

anchors.name: input_fifo_count_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO occupancy limiting reads.

anchors.name: input_fifo_full_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO full flag deasserts tready.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer, advanced on header commit.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer, advanced when header prefetched.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_full_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO full flag deasserts tready.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_empty_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO empty blocks header read.

anchors.name: int_seg_valid
anchors.why: Per input segment valid from tkeep; selects segments to pack.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_sel
anchors.why: Selects which input segment goes to each segment RAM.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_data
anchors.why: Rotated segment write data into segment RAMs.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_en
anchors.why: Per-RAM write enable on accepted input beat.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_addr_reg
anchors.why: Per-RAM write address derived from write pointer.

anchors.name: seg_mem_rd_addr_reg
anchors.why: Per-RAM read address derived from read pointer.

anchors.name: seg_mem_rd_en
anchors.why: Per-RAM read enable prefetching segments.

anchors.name: seg_mem_rd_data
anchors.why: Prefetched segment data muxed into output.

anchors.name: mem_rd_data_valid_next
anchors.why: Per-segment prefetched-data-valid, gates new segment reads.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Input framing state: start of new block versus continuing block.

anchors.name: len_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated block byte length, compared to MAX_BLOCK_LEN.

anchors.name: cycle_valid_reg
anchors.why: Registered accepted-beat valid feeding header processing stage.

anchors.name: cycle_last_reg
anchors.why: Registered tlast; ends frame and commits header.

anchors.name: hdr_len_reg
anchors.why: Pending header length written to header memory.

anchors.name: hdr_meta_reg
anchors.why: Pending header metadata; change forces new block.

anchors.name: hdr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Commits completed header by advancing header write pointer.

anchors.name: hdr_commit_prev_reg
anchors.why: Commits previous header when metadata changes mid-frame.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Triggers header memory write.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_wr_en
anchors.why: Header memory write enable.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_wr_addr
anchors.why: Header memory write address from header write pointer.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_rd_addr_reg
anchors.why: Header memory read address.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_rd_en
anchors.why: Header memory read enable on prefetch.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_rd_len
anchors.why: Read header length; sets output segment count and header field.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_rd_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Header available flag starting an output block.

anchors.name: out_frame_reg
anchors.why: Output state: new header block versus continuing segments of current block.

anchors.name: out_seg_cnt_in_reg
anchors.why: Remaining segments of current output block.

anchors.name: out_seg_last_straddle_next
anchors.why: Last data straddles an extra segment due to header offset.

anchors.name: out_seg_offset_reg
anchors.why: Output segment lane offset rotating control vectors; triggers padding.

anchors.name: out_seg_fifo_offset_reg
anchors.why: Offset into prefetched segments for segment index computation.

anchors.name: out_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Generated block header (len, last, parity, meta) inserted in output.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_en_reg
anchors.why: Per output segment enable driving output_valid.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Selects header insertion into output segment.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_split1_reg
anchors.why: Marks segment split keeping prefetched data valid.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_idx_reg
anchors.why: Selects which prefetched segment feeds each output lane.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_offset_reg
anchors.why: Starting output lane for segment mux.

anchors.name: out_shift_reg
anchors.why: Carries segment tail bytes shifted by header width.

anchors.name: block_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Idle timeout counter for partially filled output block.

anchors.name: block_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout expired; inserts padding to flush partial block.

groups.name: Input segment packer
groups.description: Splits input beats into segments and rotates them into segment RAM lanes.

groups.name: Segment input FIFO
groups.description: Segment RAM FIFO with pointers, occupancy and prefetch read logic.

groups.name: Header builder
groups.description: Tracks frames, accumulates block length/meta and commits headers.

groups.name: Header FIFO
groups.description: Header memory FIFO holding length, last and meta per block.

groups.name: Output segment controller
groups.description: Generates per-lane enables, header insertion, segment muxing and timeout padding.

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Registered segmented output data and valid.
